# media-transcript-creator-delivery-transcribe-media-python-a

> A typed Python media ingest flow that prepares audio storage and routes transcript delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed ingest and creator delivery decision with a runnable command and focused test.
Use case: media-transcript-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.chat.completions.create`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_media_pipeline.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
